subject: QuantumData order form: IP & training carveouts — proposed redlines
messages:
From: Sarah King <sarah.king@quantumdata.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantumdata.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Order form redline + IP/training questions

Olga —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with a few specific requirements we need clarified in the Order Form / MSA before we can move to countersignature:

1) Output ownership: QuantumData needs explicit assignment of rights to "Customer Output" and any derivative works for our productization use.
2) Training & feedback: We want an explicit opt-out for training on Customer Content and a narrow feedback license limited to support/debugging.
3) Telemetry & telemetry retention: We require attestations on what telemetry Redwood will collect and a 24-month retention cap with the ability to delete logs on request.

I'm attaching a short requirements doc (QD_IP_Requirements_v1.pdf) and a redline the legal team prepared that proposes stronger language than your standard OOTB order form. Can you confirm Redwood's position on assignment vs license for Customer Output and whether you can accept the training opt-out?

Procurement is on a tight schedule — aiming to have a countersigned order by next Friday 6/25. If we need legal loops, please flag estimated review ETA.

Best,
Sarah King\Director, Vendor Procurement\QuantumData

Attachment: QD_IP_Requirements_v1.pdf (8 pages)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Sarah King <sarah.king@quantumdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Order form redline + IP/training questions

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc. Appreciate the timeline note.

High level response now so procurement can keep momentum:
- Output ownership: Our standard approach is to grant customers rights to use, reproduce and commercialize Customer Output generated by the Service. We do not typically assign our core model weights or improvements. That said, we can propose more explicit language that assigns ownership of "Customer Output" and related downstream derivatives to QuantumData while carving out a narrowly scoped "feedback" license for Redwood to operate and optimize the service.
- Training opt-out: We can support a training opt-out for Customer Content provided in-scope via the Order Form. That will be implemented as an opt-out flag at the tenant level and we can include a 24-month window for telemetry retention and deletion processes.

Attached are two files: an annotated MSA redline (MSA_redline_olga_20260616.docx) and an Order Form redline (OrderForm_QD_redline_20260616.pdf) that implement the following compromises:
  * Customer Output assignment clause (new section): "Customer shall retain sole and exclusive rights in and to Customer Output and any Derivative Works thereof."
  * Feedback license (limited): "Customer grants to Redwood a worldwide, non-exclusive, revocable, royalty-free license to use Feedback solely to improve Redwood services and only in aggregated or anonymized form; no Customer PII or Customer Output shall be used to train foundational models without Customer's affirmative consent."
  * Training opt-out flag and telemetry deletion SLA (24 months) with an audit window for evidence.

Next steps: 1) Legal (Laura) — can you review the redlines for exposure? 2) Ben — can you confirm commercial acceptability (any pricing delta for telemetry retention / private logs)? 3) Sarah — if QuantumData can accept the attached wording, we can move to DocuSign.

I expect to get a formal legal review note back by end-of-day tomorrow.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov\Senior Director, Sales\Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_redline_olga_20260616.docx (tracked changes), OrderForm_QD_redline_20260616.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Order form redline + IP/training questions

Team —

Quick legal read (high level):
- Output assignment: Assigning "all rights" in Customer Output is an atypical posture for us because it can inadvertently sweep up derivative improvements that are product-level (we'd prefer to limit assignment to rights necessary for Customer's commercial use of the Output). Suggested compromise language below.

Suggested compromise (to insert into MSA redline, new sub-clause):
"Customer owns Customer Output and grants Redwood a limited license to process Customer Content and Customer Output for the sole purposes of (a) providing the Service, (b) implementing agreed operational improvements, and (c) complying with security/incident obligations. Redwood shall not use Customer Output to further train or improve Redwood's base models absent Customer's prior written consent."

- Feedback license: Replace 'revocable' with 'revocable and time-limited (max 24 months)' and explicitly require anonymization and aggregation. Avoid language that permits training of base models.

- Telemetry: Operationally we can accept retention caps and a deletion SLA; however, there will be a modest operational cost to support on-demand deletion exports and we should price that (Ben). We should also provide evidence (audit logs) as part of the order form succintly.

Action items:
1) Priyom — prepare the exact revised clause text and mark risk level (low / medium).
2) Ben — quantify the anticipated added cost to support 24-month retention + deletion requests; recommend a line item in the Order Form (one-time setup + monthly).
3) Olga — if QuantumData can accept the text below I can 1) finalize redline and 2) provide legal sign-off for DocuSign.

Laura\nChief Counsel, Contracts\Redwood Inference

1) A definite statement that no Customer Output or Feedback will be used to train or improve Redwood's foundation models without explicit written consent (acceptable per your draft).
2) Telemetry deletion SLA (24 months max) and proof of deletion within 30 days of request with an audit note provided.
3) A clean export of Customer Content/Output upon contract termination within 45 days.

We've applied our final markups to the Order Form (see attached QD_revised_orderform_redline.pdf). If the language is acceptable we will send a DocuSign link to execute.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/transaction/ABCD1234QDX

Best,
Sarah King\Director, Vendor Procurement\QuantumData
